summary: Prompt starters shows a grid of suggested tasks as cards, each with an icon, a short title and a one-line description. Picking a card writes its full prompt into the field below, word by word, and the Send button passes that prompt to your agent.
use: On an empty chat or a new workspace, when people don't know what to ask the agent first.
When you want to show what the agent is good at with real, ready-to-send tasks.
When you have more suggestions than fit on screen and want a Shuffle button to swap in another set.
features: Starters are laid out two to a row and stagger in. Each one has an `icon`, an optional `tone` that colours the icon, a `title`, a `description` and the `prompt` it writes.
Picking a card highlights it and types its prompt into the field at a word every 40 milliseconds.
The picked starter is tracked by its title and can be controlled with `value` and `onValueChange`. Setting `value` from outside fills the field the same way a click does.
Send is enabled once a starter is picked. It calls `onSend` with the prompt and then shows `sentLabel`, which defaults to "Sent to the agent".
`onShuffle` adds a Shuffle button. Pass a new `starters` set when it is called, and the cards stagger in again while the field clears.
a11y: Each starter card is a button with `aria-pressed` set on the picked one.
The Send icon button is labelled "Send" and stays disabled until a starter is picked.
With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`, the prompt appears at once instead of word by word.

faq.q: Can people edit the prompt before sending it?
faq.a: Not inside this component. Its field displays the picked prompt and is not a text input. To let people edit, look up the starter from the title `onValueChange` gives you and put its prompt into your own composer.

faq.q: How do I offer a different set of suggestions?
faq.a: Pass `onShuffle` and change `starters` when it is called. A new set clears the field and the picked starter, then the cards come in again.

faq.q: Can I pick a starter for the person, for example on first load?
faq.a: Yes. Set `value` to the starter's title from your own state and its prompt is typed into the field as if it had been clicked.
